decisions.decision: Approve all four for delivery: convoy real-004, shipment real-005, ox real-008, cargo real-002 (Recommended)
decisions.question: Gate 3 for batch C: the convoy wagon, Crown shipment, draft ox and cargo load are in the running game. The review board is open (127.0.0.1:47870), and you can play this branch's build at 127.0.0.1:47871. After the first captures, I fixed one defect. The pennant was edge-on from straight behind, so a hostile shipment's red nearly vanished. It's now enlarged and rippled, and it reads from behind. All wagon tests pass: 20/20, including every frame of every ox clip. All six deliberately broken copies are rejected, and the 9 browser tests pass. Measured cost: the site grows by 4.46 MB. On this GPU every scene is as fast or faster, and draw calls fall 30-65%. Triangles rise, so elf combat at high quality reaches 594k against the 400k budget. Under SwiftShader, frame time is within -2% to +5% of main. This is not AAA: the far sides and backs are invented; each body has a single painted albedo; the ox has cap hooves, painted eyes and a fused tail, and its gaits are procedural (canters at wagon speed); the shipment's glass is painted; and the pennant and canvas don't move. Do you approve delivery?
